It would be nice if SPRINTER were to do something reasonable on
odd-length SETQ's rather than die in SET-PREDICT.  Often debuggers
want to SPRINTER forms, and if you die due to a parens mis-match,
it is rather disconcerting for SPRINTER to die too.
